description: Provider registry for /dev-kit:llm-refresh. URLs verified against each vendor's official docs page during initial bootstrap (2026-07-17). Extraction is done by WebFetch against `url` — no per-provider parser to register here.

providers.label: Anthropic Claude
providers.note: Anthropic redirects anthropic.com/pricing → claude.com/pricing (consumer); API token pricing lives on platform.claude.com.

providers.label: OpenAI Codex / API
providers.note: platform.openai.com/docs/pricing redirects here. ChatGPT consumer-plan pricing (Plus/Pro/Team) is at chatgpt.com/pricing and is out of scope for the API registry.

providers.label: MiniMax
providers.note: MiniMax publishes LLM token pricing only on the docs/guides pages; the /document/price page is the voice-resource-package tier (TTS) and is NOT the LLM registry. Prices in docs/llm-info/minimax.json are converted from CNY to USD (extraction prompt requires the FX rate used to be recorded in each model's notes).

providers.label: DeepSeek
providers.note: Docusaurus site; one comparison table per page. Cache-hit/cache-miss both listed.
